snippet.title: Cult Vacui | Release trailer
snippet.description:
The ritual is complete. The void is calling.

Cult Vacui is finally here. Step into a haunting point-and-click horror adventure that blends tense survival mechanics with brutal time management. In a world where every second counts and every shadow hides a threat, your choices aren't just part of the story—they are the difference between life and a cold, lonely death.

Will you manage your resources and time to survive the night, or will you succumb to the vacuum?

Get it now!
